name: menu
description: Dropdown menu with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and ARIA menu semantics
designIntent: Menu presents a list of actions in a floating panel anchored to a trigger. Supports arrow-key navigation, Home/End, Escape to close, and destructive item styling.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes
Renders the item in a destructive style (MenuItem component)
props.name: destructive

examples.title: Actions menu
examples.description: Dropdown with labeled actions and a destructive item

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Menu for navigation
antiPatterns.explanation: Menu is for actions. Use links or a navigation menu for page navigation.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put forms inside a Menu
antiPatterns.explanation: Menus close on interaction. Use a Popover or Dialog for form inputs.

accessibility.implementation: role=menu on the panel, role=menuitem on items, aria-haspopup/aria-expanded on the trigger
accessibility.userRequirements: Every menu needs a labelled trigger

accessibility.implementation: Arrow keys move between items, Home/End jump to ends, Escape closes
Focus moves to items on arrow navigation and returns to trigger on close

compositionRules.relationship: Items are keyboard-navigable and close the menu on select
